historical_versus_current: The recorded B04 result stays true of what it claimed: MD-B04-A002 closure SC-MD-B04-A002-001 (114/114) under its strategy freeze. The two predicates are not claimed to have failed originally; the rule text is unchanged. Owner decision D-MD-B18-A002-018 fixes how the existing rule is realised (derived snapshot member), which creates a current conformance obligation that the recorded generic guard pair does not cover. They are NOT_ASSESSED until revalidated.

review_method.method: Every one of the 114 active mandatory B04 predicates was classified. (1) Text and section scan for snapshot, hash, canonical, registry, reason, serialization, version and identity; every hit was reviewed by hand with a recorded basis. (2) Two predicates name the reason-registry version directly and are demoted. (3) Eight predicates define the snapshot content, its canonical serialization, its hash and its binding; their proofs run through the changed producer and are re-run with the member present, not demoted. (4) The remaining predicates keep their binding with the basis recorded per row; the impact-driven regression of the attempt (full MarketData suite, 21 B10 covering files) is the check on that claim. A predicate claimed unaffected that fails there is new impact evidence.
